title: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33307v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decision models are language models fine-tuned to return a probability for each option of a typed query, which routers and guardrails threshold directly. They are built on multilingual bases but ranked almost entirely in English. We evaluate 25 top-ranked open-weight decision models on 17 tasks in 14 languages, comparing each language with English on parallel items. Every model loses accuracy in every language, from about 2 points in high-resource languages to 8 in Tamil, while confidence falls only half as much: a threshold set for 95\% accuracy in English yields 90% in Tamil. The size of the loss is set by the language and the base model rather than by leaderboard rank. In 81 controlled fine-tuning runs, task skill learned in English transfers to other languages and a few thousand target-language items narrow large losses, but neither more data nor full-parameter tuning closes them. translated_title: 迷失在翻译中，而非自信中：多语言决策模型的基准测试与校准
translated_abstract: 决策模型是经过微调的语言模型，针对类型化查询的每个选项返回一个概率，路由器和防护栏可直接对其进行阈值判断。这些模型建立在多语言基础之上，但几乎完全以英语进行排名。我们在14种语言的17个任务上评估了25个排名靠前的开源权重决策模型，在平行项目上将每种语言与英语进行比较。每个模型在每种语言中都出现了准确率下降，从高资源语言的约2个百分点到泰米尔语的8个百分点不等，而置信度的下降幅度只有准确率的一半：为英语中95%准确率设置的阈值，在泰米尔语中只能达到90%。损失的大小取决于语言和基础模型，而非排行榜排名。在81次受控微调实验中，英语中学习到的任务技能可以迁移到其他语言，几千个目标语言样本可以缩小较大的性能损失，但无论是增加更多数据还是进行全参数微调，都无法完全消除这些差距。最后，相同的测试项目……
tldr: 多语言决策模型在非英语语言中准确率显著下降（最多达8个百分点），而置信度仅下降一半，导致基于阈值的路由和防护系统失效，且增加数据或全参数微调均无法完全弥补这一跨语言性能差距。
en_tdlr: Multilingual decision models suffer significant accuracy losses across languages (up to 8 points) while confidence drops only half as much, making threshold-based routers and guardrails unreliable, and neither more data nor full-parameter fine-tuning can fully close this cross-lingual performance gap.
